resources.string: Shows a one-handed cursor when you swipe in from the screen edge, and taps wherever the cursor points. OpenQuickCursor uses this permission only to draw the cursor and perform taps. It reads no screen content and has no internet access.
Swipe in from the right edge of the screen to bring up the cursor. Move your thumb on the round pad to move the cursor, then tap the pad to tap where the cursor points.
Service is OFF. Turn it on in Accessibility settings.
